title: Continuation labels must come from the plan: fix hard-coded FROM A1 and the renderer's SEE MORE fallback
description:
getArticleFrameLabel in lib/newspaper-layout.ts:3435 returns formatContinuationSourceLabel(article, 1) for every startCursor: 'current' block, so a story continued from A2 to A3 is labelled FROM A1. components/newspaper.tsx:1142, 1145, 1181, 1184 invent SEE MORE ON A${jumpTargetPage} when jumpLabel is missing, duplicating formatContinuationJumpLabel and bypassing shortSlug. lib/layout-plan.ts:849 validates that jumpTargetPage exists but not that the target page contains a startCursor: 'current' frame for the same flowKey. ArticleFlow.placedRanges (:2092-2157) is written and never read.

Fix: derive the continuation source page from the previous committed PlacedTextRange of the same flow (use placedRanges or remove it); make jumpLabel required whenever jumpTargetPage is set and delete the renderer fallbacks; extend validateEditionLayoutPlanForItems to require a continuation frame on the advertised page. Also move the pilot fixture slugs in getDefaultCutPolicy (lib/layout-plan.ts:957: agent-procedure-patterns, schools-reading-lab, market-hall) into lib/layout-scenarios.ts.

Done when: the two-hop label scenario in the solver test passes and grep 'SEE MORE ON A$' components returns nothing.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
